```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.retina = 2)
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(ggplot2)
library(scales); library(forcats)

capture   <- snakemake@wildcards[["capture_id"]]
pool      <- snakemake@params[["pool_id"]]
# pool_id is optional in captures.csv
pool_disp <- if (is.null(pool) || is.na(pool) || !nzchar(pool)) "\u2014" else pool

# Summary figures come from the metrics roll-up rather than being recomputed
# here, so this page and the index cannot disagree. Pin the text columns for the
# same reason report_index.Rmd does: this is a single-row file, so a capture
# missing one numerically-named sample gets missing_samples inferred as double,
# and strsplit() below rejects a non-character argument.
mx <- read_tsv(snakemake@input[["metrics"]],
               col_types = cols(.default = col_guess(),
                                capture_id      = col_character(),
                                pool_id         = col_character(),
                                missing_samples = col_character()))

assign_tbl <- read_tsv(snakemake@input[["assignments"]], show_col_types = FALSE)
# sample_id must be read as character, not left to type inference. Since #22
# restored the droplet-type literals, all_cells_stats.tsv carries "doublet" and
# "unassigned" rows and infers character, while all_singlets_stats.tsv holds
# only sample ids -- numeric for many captures -- and infers double. The two
# then refuse to join.
ID <- cols(sample_id = col_character())
all_cells    <- read_tsv(snakemake@input[["all_cells"]], col_types = ID)
all_singlets <- read_tsv(snakemake@input[["all_singlets"]], col_types = ID)
amb_stats  <- read_csv(snakemake@input[["ambient_stats"]], show_col_types = FALSE)

# The five callers, each contributing a DropletType and an Individual_Assignment
# column, plus the demuxafy consensus.
methods   <- c("Demuxlet", "Freemuxlet", "Souporcell", "Vireo", "Souporcell_vireosnp")
consensus <- "AtLeastHalfSinglet"

n_cells   <- mx$n_barcodes
n_singlet <- mx$n_singlet
n_doublet <- mx$n_doublet
n_unassig <- mx$n_unassigned
missing   <- if (is.na(mx$missing_samples) || !nzchar(mx$missing_samples)) {
  character(0)
} else {
  strsplit(mx$missing_samples, ";")[[1]]
}
```

# `r capture`

## Donor present/absent screen

Clustering-independent pre-flight QC flag (a flag only -- nothing downstream acts
on it): for each declared pool donor, is it actually **present** in this capture?
Private sites are biallelic panel sites where a donor is the sole alt-carrier among
pool donors; per cell we count covered private sites carrying an alt read.
`n_evidence` = cells showing several private alleles at once. Verdicts:
**present** (enough evidence cells), **absent** (testable but no evidence /
dropout), **untestable** (too few private sites covered). `ambient_p` is the pooled
alt-fraction over the donor's private rows (context only). Non-`present` donors are
listed first.

```{r present-absent, results='asis'}
pa_path <- snakemake@input[["present_absent"]]
pa <- if (is.null(pa_path) || !file.exists(pa_path) || file.info(pa_path)$size == 0) {
  NULL
} else {
  out <- tryCatch(read_tsv(pa_path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out) || nrow(out) == 0) NULL else out
}

if (is.null(pa)) {
  cat("\n> _No present/absent screen for this capture (empty or missing input)._\n")
} else {
  n_present <- sum(pa$verdict == "present", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_absent  <- sum(pa$verdict == "absent", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_untest  <- sum(pa$verdict == "untestable", na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n**%d donor(s):** %d present, %d absent, %d untestable.\n\n",
    nrow(pa), n_present, n_absent, n_untest))
  flagged <- pa$donor[pa$verdict != "present"]
  if (length(flagged)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n> **Flagged (not called present): %s**\n\n",
                paste(flagged, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  # TSV is already sorted non-`present` first; show the decision-relevant columns.
  pa %>%
    transmute(
      donor,
      verdict,
      n_evidence,
      `cells >=3` = cells_ge3,
      `cells >=5` = cells_ge5,
      ambient_p,
      n_private,
      n_covered
    ) %>%
    knitr::kable() %>% print()
}
```

```{r negative-test, results='asis'}
nt_path <- snakemake@input[["negative_test"]]
nt <- if (is.null(nt_path) || !file.exists(nt_path) || file.info(nt_path)$size == 0) {
  NULL
} else {
  tryCatch(read_tsv(nt_path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
}
if (!is.null(nt) && nrow(nt) && any(nt$genotype_verdict != "none", na.rm = TRUE)) {
  r <- nt[nt$genotype_verdict != "none", ][1, ]
  closest <- if (!is.na(r$max_frac_donor) && nzchar(as.character(r$max_frac_donor))) {
    sprintf(" (closest known donor %s, frac %s)", r$max_frac_donor, r$max_frac)
  } else ""
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0("\n### By-elimination recovery check\n\nDonor **%s** has no known genotype ",
           "and was recovered by elimination (**%s** cells). Post-hoc: **genotype = %s**%s; ",
           "**sex = %s**.\n\n"),
    r$ungenotyped, r$n_recovered, r$genotype_verdict, closest, r$sex_verdict))
  cat(paste0("> _`likely-real` = distinct from every known donor; `related->d` = a distinct ",
             "donor but a first-degree relative of d (het-mixed at d's hom-alt sites); ",
             "`suspect->d` = looks like donor d itself (probable mislabel / souporcell ",
             "over-split); `doublet-lump` = matches >=2 donors; sex `MIXED` flags a ",
             "doublet/ambient lump. The related/suspect split is finalised cohort-wide in ",
             "the aggregated summary (best-powered capture of each donor pair)._\n\n"))
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
tibble(
  Field = c("Capture", "Pool", "Barcodes", "Singlets", "Doublets",
            "Unassigned", "Samples declared", "Samples recovered",
            "Ambient RNA (souporcell)"),
  Value = c(capture, pool_disp, comma(n_cells),
            sprintf("%s (%s)", comma(n_singlet), percent(n_singlet / n_cells, 0.1)),
            sprintf("%s (%s)", comma(n_doublet), percent(n_doublet / n_cells, 0.1)),
            sprintf("%s (%s)", comma(n_unassig), percent(n_unassig / n_cells, 0.1)),
            mx$n_declared, mx$n_recovered,
            if (is.na(mx$ambient_souporcell)) "n/a"
            else percent(mx$ambient_souporcell, 0.01))
) %>% knitr::kable()
```

```{r missing-donors, results='asis'}
if (length(missing)) {
  cat("\n> **", length(missing), " declared sample(s) not recovered as singlets: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "**\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Cell counts by sample

```{r per-sample, fig.height=3.2}
all_cells %>%
  mutate(sample_id = fct_reorder(as.character(sample_id), number_of_cells)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_cells, y = sample_id)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Cells", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r per-sample-table}
# all_singlets adds the share-of-singlets denominator, which is the more useful
# figure when a capture has a high doublet rate.
all_cells %>%
  select(-any_of("capture_id")) %>%
  left_join(
    all_singlets %>% select(sample_id, fraction_of_all_singlets_captured),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## Ambient RNA

`souporcell` reports a single figure for the capture; `vireo` estimates a
fraction per barcode, binned below.

```{r ambient, fig.height=3.2}
ggplot(amb_stats, aes(x = bin, y = frac)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Ambient RNA fraction", y = "Barcodes",
       subtitle = sprintf("median per-barcode estimate: %s",
                          percent(mx$ambient_vireo_median, 0.01))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
```

## Agreement between methods

```{r consensus-prep}
# Long form: one row per (barcode, method) carrying that method's call. A call
# is the sample id for a singlet, or the droplet type otherwise, so that
# "doublet" and "unassigned" are comparable across methods alongside identity.
long <- lapply(methods, function(m) {
  tibble(
    Barcode = assign_tbl$Barcode,
    method  = m,
    dtype   = assign_tbl[[paste0(m, "_DropletType")]],
    ind     = assign_tbl[[paste0(m, "_Individual_Assignment")]]
  )
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(call = if_else(dtype == "singlet" & !is.na(ind) & !ind %in% c("doublet", "unassigned"),
                        ind, dtype))

cons <- tibble(
  Barcode = assign_tbl$Barcode,
  dtype   = assign_tbl[[paste0(consensus, "_DropletType")]],
  ind     = assign_tbl[[paste0(consensus, "_Individual_Assignment")]]
) %>%
  mutate(call = if_else(dtype == "singlet" & !is.na(ind) & !ind %in% c("doublet", "unassigned"),
                        ind, dtype))
```

### Calls by method

Rows are the callers, the bottom row the demuxafy consensus. A sample missed by
one method shows as a gap in an otherwise populated column.

```{r method-matrix, fig.height=3.4}
mat <- bind_rows(long %>% select(Barcode, method, call),
                 cons %>% transmute(Barcode, method = consensus, call)) %>%
  count(method, call, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = rev(c(methods, consensus))))

ggplot(mat, aes(x = call, y = method, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(n)), size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eef3f8", high = "#2c6fa8", labels = comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Cells") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
```

### How many methods back the consensus

```{r agreement, fig.height=3}
agree <- long %>%
  left_join(cons %>% select(Barcode, cons_call = call), by = "Barcode") %>%
  group_by(Barcode) %>%
  summarise(n_agree = sum(call == cons_call, na.rm = TRUE),
            cons_call = first(cons_call), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cons_type = case_when(cons_call == "doublet" ~ "doublet",
                               cons_call == "unassigned" ~ "unassigned",
                               TRUE ~ "singlet"))

ggplot(agree, aes(x = factor(n_agree, levels = 0:length(methods)), fill = cons_type)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(singlet = "#2c6fa8", doublet = "#c0504d",
                               unassigned = "#9e9e9e")) +
  labs(x = sprintf("Methods agreeing with the consensus (of %d)", length(methods)),
       y = "Barcodes", fill = "Consensus") +
  theme_classic()
```

### Pairwise concordance

Percent identical individual assignment, over barcodes both methods call a
singlet. Diagnostic: one method drifting from the rest shows as a cold row.

```{r concordance, fig.height=3.6, fig.width=6}
wide <- long %>% select(Barcode, method, call) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = call)
sing <- long %>% select(Barcode, method, dtype) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = dtype)

pairs <- expand.grid(a = methods, b = methods, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pct = {
    keep <- sing[[a]] == "singlet" & sing[[b]] == "singlet"
    keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE
    if (!any(keep)) NA_real_ else mean(wide[[a]][keep] == wide[[b]][keep], na.rm = TRUE)
  }) %>% ungroup()

ggplot(pairs, aes(x = a, y = b, fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(pct), "-", percent(pct, 0.1))), size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7e6e4", high = "#2c6fa8", labels = percent,
                      limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Concordance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r diagnostics, results='asis'}
# html_document is self-contained by default, so include_graphics() embeds

figs <- list(
  list(path = snakemake@input[["vireosnp_heatmap"]],
       title = "souporcell / vireosnp: cluster-to-genotype match"),
  list(path = snakemake@input[["gt_distance"]],
       title = "vireo: genotype distance"),
  list(path = snakemake@input[["freemuxlet_corr"]],
       title = "freemuxlet: reference cluster correlation")
)
for (f in figs) {

  cat(sprintf('![](%s)\n', normalizePath(f$path)))
}
```

## Donor diagnostics

QC gates from the hierarchical design (docs/hierarchical_demux_design.md §D/§E):
donor distinctiveness and MAF-survival of private sites, the variant-space
embedding coloured by de-novo cluster with its silhouette, and a score-level
leave-one-out check of whether each donor's cluster survives as distinct.

```{r diag-helpers}
# Robust reader: an empty-but-valid TSV (produced when an input was missing)
# yields NULL so the chunks below print a placeholder note instead of erroring.
read_diag <- function(key) {
  path <- snakemake@input[[key]]
  if (is.null(path) || !file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size == 0) return(NULL)
  out <- tryCatch(read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out) || nrow(out) == 0) NULL else out
}
```

### Distinctiveness and MAF survival

Per donor: `n_unique` = sites where it is the sole alt-carrier among pool donors;
`keep@t` = fraction of those sites whose pooled allele fraction survives threshold
`t`. Low survival at `0.1` is the minMAF-culling failure mode for minority donors.

```{r distinctiveness, results='asis'}
dist_tbl <- read_diag("distinctiveness_tsv")
if (is.null(dist_tbl)) {
  cat("\n> _No distinctiveness data for this capture._\n")
} else {
  print(knitr::kable(dist_tbl))
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(sprintf('![](%s)\n',
              normalizePath(snakemake@input[["distinctiveness_png"]])))
}
```

### Variant-space embedding

De-novo souporcell clusters in the variant (alt-fraction) space. A clear
separation with a positive silhouette indicates recoverable donors; a collapsed
embedding / near-zero silhouette flags the too-few-cells failure mode.

```{r embedding, results='asis'}
emb <- read_diag("embedding_metrics")
if (!is.null(emb)) {
  ov <- emb$silhouette[emb$cluster == "overall"]
  if (length(ov)) cat(sprintf("\nOverall silhouette: **%.3f**\n\n", ov[1]))
  print(knitr::kable(emb))
  cat("\n\n")
}
epng <- snakemake@input[["embedding_png"]]
if (!is.null(epng) && file.exists(epng)) {
  cat(sprintf('![](%s)\n', normalizePath(epng)))
} else {
  cat("\n> _No embedding for this capture._\n")
}
```

### Leave-one-out

Drop each donor and check whether its best cluster stays distinct (a clear
GPb_diff gap to the next-best donor) or gets absorbed (another donor is within
the margin). Absorbed donors are not separable by genotype alone.

```{r leave-one-out, results='asis'}
loo <- read_diag("leave_one_out")
if (is.null(loo)) {
  cat("\n> _No leave-one-out data for this capture._\n")
} else {
  n_abs <- sum(loo$verdict == "absorbed", na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d donor(s) absorbed (not separable).\n\n",
              n_abs, nrow(loo)))
  print(knitr::kable(loo))
}
```
